subject: Azimuth RFI — control scope clarification and artifact delivery plan
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@azimuth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: Leah Wong <leah.wong@azimuth.com>, security@azimuth.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: RFI: Requested control mappings and artifact delivery windows

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for taking our call yesterday. As discussed, procurement and our security team would like a control-level mapping for SOC 2 / ISO 27001 scopes and an estimated timeline for delivering artifacts. To be specific, we need:

- A crosswalk that maps your controls to Azimuth's SIG sections and ISO 27001 clauses (CSV or Excel).
- Representative artifacts for the following areas: access control (privileged access), key management (KMS rotation logs), and network segmentation diagrams.
- Confirmation of whether you can include time-bound evidence (e.g., last 30/90-day logs) or only policy-level documents.

Can you confirm an ETA for the crosswalk and a delivery plan for artifacts? Leah in procurement is looping on timelines and DocuSign steps for an NDA if needed.

Appreciate it — small pilot PoC next month, so tight timeline.

Best,
Samir

--
Samir Patel
Director, Vendor Security & Ops
Azimuth Systems
attachments: azimuth_rfi_questions.pdf (pdf, 78KB)

From: irene.choi@redwood.com

Subject: Re: RFI: Requested control mappings and artifact delivery windows

Samir / Leah —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can provide a control crosswalk and a focused evidence bundle. High-level plan below:

1) Control crosswalk (Excel) — maps Redwood controls to SOC 2 CC, ISO 27001 clauses and SIG questions.
2) Evidence bundle — a curated set of artifacts (policy, config export, redacted logs) for privileged access, KMS rotation, and network segmentation.
3) Time window — we can include sample logs for the last 30 days for telemetry and KMS rotation proof; for deeper historical logs we need a request window (we keep 12 months, but retrieval requires 3 business days).
4) Delivery cadence — initial crosswalk + index by EOD Tue 29 Jun, artifacts packaged Wed 30 Jun; secure link + checklist shipped to your security mailbox.

If you need the material earlier for a procurement review, we can compress to Mon/Tue with a gated handoff (redacted logs only).

Next steps: Leah, would you prefer the crosswalk posted to a temporary secure Drive link or uploaded to your procurement portal? Samir, I will attach the control_map and network diagram in my next message (internal review first).

Thanks —
Irene

Irene — forwarding Azimuth's ask and your proposed timeline. Security/infra: can you confirm the following before we finalize the bundle?

- KMS rotation evidence: sample of rotation schedule + a CSV export of last rotation events (timestamps, key_id, user_id). Are there any privacy/redaction concerns?
- Network segmentation: likely need to pull an updated diagram that differentiates control plane from customer inference plane; jonas, can infra produce v2 of the diagram by EOD Mon?
- Privileged access: we should include our access review cadence and a last-signed attestation (PDF).

Irene, if retrieval is going to push past Tue, call out the blockers to Samir so procurement has visibility. I'm marking this high priority — pilot is time-boxed.

Thanks,
Karthik

Irene / Karthik —

Attached are the updated artifacts we discussed. Key notes:

- redwood_network_architecture_v2.pdf: shows control-plane separation, tenant isolation boundaries, and north-south firewalling.
- kms_rotation_sample.csv: contains synthetic activity rows but mirrors the schema we will export for real customer samples (we redact user ids for the stakeholder copy).
- redwood_azimuth_control_crosswalk_v1.xlsx: preliminary mapping; we flagged four SIG items that map to multiple internal controls and added comments where we expect follow-up questions.

I am handing these to Irene for the gated handoff. If Azimuth needs raw logs (full user ids), we will require an executed NDA and a short evidence access request.

On timelines — the crosswalk + index is ready; the artifacts are packaged and I recommend we deliver via a secure temporary Drive link with 7-day expiry.

Regards,
Jonas
